args.sql:
SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS fan_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
GROUP BY 
    f.userregistry
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) > 1
ORDER BY 
    idol_count DESC;

WITH FanIdolCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry AS fan_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
    GROUP BY 
        f.userregistry
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) > 1
),
FanIdolInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        fic.fan_id,
        f.nicklabel AS fan_nickname,
        fic.idol_count,
        GROUP_CONCAT(vi.nametag) AS idol_names,
        AVG(e.engrate) AS avg_engagement
    FROM 
        FanIdolCounts fic
    JOIN 
        fans f ON fic.fan_id = f.userregistry
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
    JOIN 
        virtualidols vi ON i.interactidolpivot = vi.entityreg
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
    GROUP BY 
        fic.fan_id, f.nicklabel, fic.idol_count
)
SELECT 
    f.fan_id,
    f.fan_nickname,
    f.idol_count,
    f.idol_names,
    f.avg_engagement
FROM 
    FanIdolInfo f
ORDER BY 
    f.idol_count DESC, f.avg_engagement DESC;
